query:
SELECT 'tournaments' AS source_table, game AS game_value, COUNT(*) AS count
FROM tournaments
GROUP BY game
UNION ALL
SELECT 'teams' AS source_table, game AS game_value, COUNT(*) AS count
FROM teams
WHERE game IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY game
ORDER BY source_table, count DESC;
